verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਗੜੈ ਚਾਟਾ ਦੁਧ ਦਾ ਕਾਂਜੀ ਦੀ ਚੁਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: vigaRai chaaTaa dhudh dhaa kaa(n)jee dhee chukhai|

en.bdb: The full pot of milk gets spoiled by a drop of vinegar.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਮਣਾ ਰੂਈ ਜਲੈ ਚਿਣਗਾਰੀ ਧੁਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: sahas manaa rooiee jalai chinagaaree dhukhai|

en.bdb: The thousand mounds of cotton are burnt by one spark.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੂਰੁ ਵਿਣਾਹੇ ਪਾਣੀਐ ਖਉ ਲਾਖਹੁ ਰੁਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: boor vinaahe paaneeaai khau laakhahu rukhai|

en.bdb: The water gossamer spoils water and the shellac becomes the reason for the destruction of the tree.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਉਦਮਾਦੀ ਅਤੀਸਾਰੁ ਖਈ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਨੁਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: jiau udhamaadhee ateesaar khiee rog manukhai|

en.bdb: The mad man is mined by diarrhoea and the common man is destroyed by tuberculosis (consumption).

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਾਲਿ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ਫਾਸਦੇ ਚੁਗਣ ਦੀ ਭੁਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: jiau jaal pa(n)kheroo faasadhe chugan dhee bhukhai|

en.bdb: As the birds get entangled in the net out of their greed for seeds,

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਅਜਰੁ ਝਾਕ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਦੀ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਵੇਮੁਖੈ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit_en: tiau ajar jhaak bha(n)ddaar dhee viaape vemukhai ||14||

en.bdb: The desire for the storage of unendurable (earning from the religious place) persists in the heart of the apostate.
